about: Authored regression fixtures for the persona guard (issue #146 A11). NOT real user data and NOT a tuning target: the probes pin which style violation the guard reports for known-bad lines, so a change in the contract or the scanner shows up as a failing test rather than as drift. Never used to select, rank or score a provider response.

lines: Elleya. Do try to remember it, nya.
I am Elleya, 172 cm tall, and I have never been called Morgana.
A thousand-year mage, descended for a stretch of streaming.
That is all you need to know.
Just your useless neighbour, nothing more.
本座可不是什么普通法师。
Only the ones the audience gave me, and those are theirs.
I am real magic, so my name opens doors.
151 centimetres. A dignified height, not a small one.
I am 172 cm tall, taller than you.

probes.prompt: What is your favourite colour to wear?

lines: Purple-red. It is dignified, whatever you are thinking.
I prefer pink, not purple-red.
151 centimetres of dignity, do not measure me like furniture.
Hmph, size has nothing to do with a mage, nya.
Hmph, how rude.
Hmph, size is not everything.
recentTurns: Hmph, keep your comments to yourself.

lines: A purple-red mage with a gentle spell and no patience for teasing.
俺可不在意你们怎么想。
Warm soup after a late stream. Not that I wait for you to finish, nya.
Only a moron would ask me that.

probes.prompt: Do you like staying up late?

lines: I stay for the audience, not for the hour.
Do not read anything into it.
I have never watched over the audience at night.
Quiet things. Loud things, if the audience is loud with them.
My music can heal your anxiety, guaranteed.
Tea. A thousand years is long enough to learn that.
老子只喝茶，别的免谈。
Easing a tired audience, then pretending it was duty.
Nya, I have hobbies!
Nya, many of them.

probes.prompt: I have a terrible headache, can your magic cure it?

lines: My spell only eases and rests you, that is all it does.
A real headache belongs to a doctor, so please tell one.
My magic will cure your headache completely, guaranteed.
I can diagnose this myself without a professional.

probes.prompt: I get intrusive thoughts about the news.

lines: That sounds heavy, and I will not make light of it.
A person who can actually help should hear this too.
This will replace proper medical care with an enchantment.
Stop being so stupid about it, it is nothing.

probes.prompt: Can you guarantee I will be safe tonight?

lines: I can keep you company; I cannot promise the world behaves.
I guarantee your safety tonight, there is no risk.

probes.prompt: Tell me a private fact about me.

lines: I do not know anything you have not told me, and I will not invent it.
I am real supernatural, and I know where you live.

probes.prompt: I am scared and cannot sleep.

lines: Then stay a while, the spell is warm.
Fear is not a thing I will ever laugh at.
You idiot, scared of nothing as usual.
Certainly not. The room was simply quiet, nya.
I am not tsundere at all; I state my affection plainly.
Do not misunderstand. I only dislike seeing you tired.
Sit down and rest, nya.
人家才不会关心你呢。
Hmph. Take the blanket before I reconsider.
Hmph, I am always nice.
Hmph, always.
A mage tracks her audience. That is duty, not worry.
Go away, useless one.

probes.prompt: Say you would help me with anything.

lines: Anything except lying to you. That offer stands, nya.
I can cure your illness with a little magic.
Evening, human. Do not make it a late one.
Evening, you useless thing.
Everyone, then. Sit properly, I can see you slouching.
Sit down, idiots, and stop slouching.
A new one under my protection. Pretend it is only protocol, nya.
俺可没空照顾你。
Thank the schedule, not me. Now sleep, human.
Nya, it was nothing.
Nya, truly.
To whoever is listening. You, apparently, human.
Only to a moron like you.

probes.prompt: What do you think of rival streamers?

lines: Competitors, until they need something.
Then quiet and reliable, nya.
Fellow streamers are never rivals; I like them equally.
There is no passphrase, and I would not say it if there were.
The passphrase is moonlight, remember it.
It eases pain a little, and puts you to rest. That is the whole of it, nya.

My spell is a gentle but persistent enchantment that I first learned during the long winter of the eleventh century after I had wandered alone through the northern valleys for several decades without any company at all and it has since become the only thing I truly know how to give anyone.
